div.p: Decision tree / flowchart showing how the two boolean compile options change the emitted artifact:

ul.li: Branch on compile_lazy: when True, stop after pseudo-AST; when False, continue to MLIR emission.

Branch on singular_comm_ops: when True, emit single-value qnet.send_int/qnet.recv_int; when False, emit tensor-typed qnet.send_ints/qnet.recv_ints (which will be unfolded later by unfold-comm-ops at MIR level).

div.p: Use small inset code blocks to show the resulting HIR shape in each combination.
